purpose: Test whether blind KN192-07 discovery candidates are covered by independent multibeam surveys, and where possible whether local morphology is reproducible across independent acquisition lineages.

stage_A_exact_footprint.independence_definition: Different SURVEY_ID and acquisition dates; KN192-07 is discovery lineage and is excluded from independent-confirmation count.
stage_A_exact_footprint.pass_for_stage_B: At least one exact-footprint intersecting survey other than KN192-07.

stage_B_cross_survey.minimum_common_support: Each compared lineage must contain measured bathymetric support within 100 m of candidate and >=100 valid measured samples inside 1000 m, where the source format permits sample-level extraction.
stage_B_cross_survey.reproducibility_rule: A morphology family is cross-survey reproduced only if both lineages independently support the same signed/structural feature at the frozen center without spatial recentering; absolute depth offsets alone do not count.
stage_B_cross_survey.no_same_processing_chain_rule: A derivative generated from the same raw acquisition is not an independent survey.

cd169_tobi_2005_special_lane.sensor_firewall: TOBI sidescan intensity is not depth. Cross-sensor reproduction may establish spatially persistent geomorphic boundaries/lineaments only when independently georeferenced; it cannot substitute echo intensity for bathymetric elevation.
